name: zovo-msgpack-viewer
description: MsgPack viewer for VS Code: open MessagePack (.msgpack, .mpk), BSON and CBOR files as a tree with types, sizes and byte offsets, read streams of many values, see any value as JSON and copy it, and search keys and values. Bad data shows its byte offset. Offline, no account.

msgpackViewer.showProTools.description: Show the Zovo Pro tools (convert, edit a value, compare, batch convert) in the Command Palette, the Explorer menu, the editor title menu and the viewer toolbar. Everything free stays visible.

msgpackViewer.askForRating.description: Ask once for a Marketplace rating after files opened without an error on two occasions at least 30 minutes apart. "Later" asks one more time after 7 days, "No thanks" never asks again. Nothing is sent anywhere.

msgpackViewer.showSupportLinks.description: Show the small Rate, More free tools and Zovo Pro links at the bottom of the viewer. Nothing is sent anywhere.

zovo.msgpack.trial.enabled.description: Show the 7-day Zovo Pro trial button in the Pro panel.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with MsgPack Viewer & BSON, CBOR
walkthroughs.description: Read MessagePack, CBOR and BSON files as a tree of values inside VS Code.

steps.title: Open a file
steps.description:
Files ending in .msgpack, .mpk, .cbor and .bson open in the viewer. Any other file opens with Open a File as MessagePack, CBOR or BSON in the Command Palette.
[Open a sample file](command:msgpackViewer.openSample)

media.altText: A MessagePack file with three order records open in the viewer: the tree with keys, types, byte offsets and sizes, and the details of the selected value with its bytes.

steps.title: JSON view, copy and search
steps.description: Click JSON in the toolbar to see the selected value as JSON, and Copy JSON to copy it. Type in the search box to find keys and values anywhere in the file; a click on a match opens it in the tree.

steps.title: Bad data and byte offsets
steps.description: Every row shows the byte offset and the size of its value. When the data is damaged or cut short, a note names the byte where reading stopped, and every value before it still shows.

steps.title: Convert, edit, compare, batch
steps.description: Zovo Pro tools, 1 free try each: convert to JSON and back, edit a value and save it in the same format, compare two files, and convert a whole folder to JSON.

steps.title: Tools that often go with binary JSON
steps.description:
If your project also has raw binary files, JSON Lines or Avro files, these free Zovo extensions open them. A link opens the extension page, and you choose there whether to install it.
[Hex Viewer & Binary Viewer](command:extension.open?%5B%22zovo.zovo-hex-viewer%22%5D)
[JSONL Viewer](command:extension.open?%5B%22zovo.zovo-jsonl-viewer%22%5D)
